title: Is Amazon Grocery worth it? Yes—here’s what to know.
summary: With everyday low prices and Same-Day Delivery in more than 2,300 U.S. cities and towns, Amazon Grocery is helping customers save more and shop faster on fresh groceries and everyday essentials.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- [Amazon Grocery](https://www.amazon.com/fmc/learn-more) offers fresh groceries and everyday essentials with free


[Same-Day Delivery](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/amazon-prime/amazon-same-day-delivery) on orders over $25 in more than 2,300 U.S. cities and towns, with everyday low prices that meet or beat other retailers.


- Amazon Grocery’s selection has grown significantly, with over


6,000 items added to the service across fresh produce, pantry staples, and household essentials.


- Customers are choosing Amazon for more of their grocery shopping, making it the second-largest grocer in the U.S. Over the past year, Prime members have more than tripled their monthly free Same-Day Delivery orders of fresh groceries.


- This Thanksgiving, customers can get a complete meal for just $25 with Same-Day Delivery and turkeys as low as $0.79 per lb.


---


More people are turning to Amazon for their grocery shopping—and with good reason.


[Amazon Grocery](https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-grocery-delivery-works) delivers fresh groceries, pantry staples, and everyday essentials to more than


[2,300 cities and towns](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-same-day-fresh-grocery-delivery-united-states) nationwide, with


[everyday low prices](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-orders-savings-discounts-shopping) and Same-Day Delivery.


[How Amazon and Prime make everyday life more affordable for American families](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-affordable-everyday-savings)


Amazon and Prime deliver billions in savings every year—averaging over $1,000 per customer for 100+ million customers—through everyday low prices, deals, time-saving free delivery, and fuel savings—plus prescription savings.


The selection keeps growing, too. Amazon has added thousands of new grocery items in the past year, from fresh produce and dairy to brands like 365 by Whole Foods Market, Pillsbury, and Birds Eye. And this Thanksgiving, customers can get a complete holiday meal for $25 delivered to their door fast with Same-Day Delivery.


Here’s everything customers need to know about shopping for groceries on Amazon.


## What can you get from Amazon Grocery?


Customers have more grocery options on Amazon, with over 6,000 items added in the last six months alone across fresh produce, pantry staples, and more. This includes more than 300 new items from 365 by Whole Foods Market, expanded selection from brands customers know and love like Dove, Starbucks, Pillsbury, and Birds Eye, and hundreds of new brands recently added to Amazon’s grocery selection. Amazon’s Same-Day Delivery fulfillment centers offer tens of thousands of grocery and everyday household essentials items, four times that of a typical grocery store’s total selection, and customers can add millions of other items available for Same-Day Delivery to the same cart.


[Amazon sets new Prime delivery speed record in 2025](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-same-day-next-day-delivery-2025)


Over 13 billion items arrived the same or next day around the world.


## How does Amazon Grocery delivery work?


Customers can order fresh groceries alongside millions of other items and check out from a single cart. Eligible perishable grocery items carry


[Amazon’s Freshness Guarantee](https://www.amazon.com/fmc/m/40002344/fresh/freshnessguarantee?almBrandId=QW1hem9uIEZyZXNo) —if a customer is not satisfied, Amazon makes it right.


Amazon offers multiple ways to get fresh groceries delivered, but the most popular option is


[Same-Day Delivery](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/amazon-prime/amazon-same-day-delivery) —which lets customers shop for fresh produce, meat, dairy, frozen foods, and more alongside millions of other items on Amazon, all in one cart.


For customers who need groceries even faster,


[Amazon Now](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-now-30-minute-delivery) delivers thousands of items in 30 minutes or less in select cities, with even more expansion planned in the coming year.


## How much does Amazon Grocery delivery cost?


[Prime members](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-benefits) receive Same-Day Delivery for free on orders over $25. If an order doesn’t meet the minimum, members can still choose Same-Day Delivery for a $2.99 fee. For customers without a Prime membership, the service is available with a $12.99 fee, regardless of order size.


## Is Amazon Grocery cheaper than other options?


[Amazon makes life more affordable](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-affordable-everyday-savings) by offering the lowest prices every day that meet or beat other retailers across hundreds of millions of products spanning more than 35 categories, including groceries, everyday essentials, apparel, beauty, and more.


Beyond everyday low prices, customers saved an average of over $230 on groceries, household essentials, and other products last year through Subscribe & Save (up to 15% off through auto-delivery), coupons, and deals with


[validated savings](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-amazon-offers-genuine-deals-to-customers) throughout the year. Amazon’s grocery private brands—Amazon Grocery and Amazon Saver—offer more than 1,200 products, with the vast majority priced under $5.


Qualifying government-assistance recipients and income-verified customers can save even more through


[Amazon Access](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) , which offers 15% to 20% off select groceries and everyday essentials.


[Inside the grocery operation Amazon built to be pickier than you](https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-grocery-delivery-works)


From cherry taste tests to banana ripening rooms, here’s what happens before your Amazon groceries reach your door.


## What Thanksgiving grocery deals does Amazon offer?


With Amazon Grocery’s expanded selection, customers can now shop for everything they need for their holiday table in one place—from the turkey to the sides to the pie crust. And this Thanksgiving, Amazon Grocery is making it even more affordable with a meal for just $25 with Same-Day Delivery and turkeys as low as $0.79 per pound. Available through November 26 while supplies last, the meal includes an 8-pound Butterball frozen turkey plus ingredients for classic sides and dessert, including Ocean Spray cranberry sauce, Kraft Mac & Cheese, Stove Top stuffing, and more.


Here are additional Thanksgiving deals:


- Frozen turkey for $0.79 per pound from November 1 through November 26


- Fresh turkey for $0.99 per pound from November 14 through November 26


- Thanksgiving staples under $4 from November 1 through November 26


- 40% off charcuterie and party snacks from November 2 through November 14


- 40% off premade sides from November 15 through November 26


Customers can visit the Amazon


[Thanksgiving meal page](https://www.amazon.com/fmc/m/40003970/grocery-store-mode/2026thanksgiving?gsc=fe15Lls6uIyOG) or search “$25 Thanksgiving Meal” in the Amazon app to shop more Thanksgiving deals.
